title: Airship Seating

reward.description: A collapsible spyglass. Through it, distant clouds look suspiciously like sheep.

hints: seats[r][c] is the seat in row r, column c. Loop with for r in range(len(seats)): for c in range(len(seats[r])):
For book, check the row and column are in range BEFORE looking at seats[row][col], then change it to "X".
A free pair is two "." next to each other in the same row: check seats[r][c] and seats[r][c + 1] for c up to len(row) - 2.
